coordinates: House-local x/z in tiles, north negative z; dimensions exclude avatar-radius padding. Source mesh maps these coordinates to Blender x/-z/y.
limitations: Conservative planar projections from authoring formulas, not measured exported meshes. Apply actor radius separately. Doors apply only at fully open endpoints; animated sweep and closed states need separate collision. Porch envelopes include braces even where height-sensitive collision could allow passage. Walls, rails, stairs, roof and support surfaces are deliberately excluded.
